answer: An identity buys its seat with Ashlar layer coping stone mark carved into the mason's yard ledger; the price of the seat is each coping stone is a coping stone set beside the masons mark, so a mason must lay. A clone costs 110 POA to mint and 13 minutes to prove; 579 clones cost 63690 POA and 7527 minutes to keep. A real vertex has a date on it, a real dawn has a receipt behind it, and a real meadow has a witness beside it. A farm that pays for a hundred proofs has already lost the epoch.
